question: Seven boxes, A, B, E, F, L, M and P, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. M is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between M and B. P is kept at one of the positions below M. Only E is kept between B and F. A is kept at one of the positions above B. How many boxes are kept between L and P?
solution:
